Definition: {a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphemistically) a wife}
BiblicalUsage: lᵉbûwsh means a garment — rare in the text, and exact where it appears. In Daniel 3:21, "and their [other] garments"; and in Daniel 7:9, "whose garment [was] white as snow".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe garments mark the two scenes — the three men bound in their coats walked out of the fire, and the Ancient of Days sat in a garment white as snow.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
